caption: The drawing depicts two objects side by side on a light brown or tan background. On the left is a grayish, weathered ceramic vessel with a wide, uneven mouth and a bulbous body that narrows toward the base. The rim of the vessel features a band of subtle geometric patterns, and the body of the vessel exhibits signs of cracking and wear. On the right is a black skirt or tunic adorned with colorful decorative details. The garment has a round neckline edged with yellow and decorated with intricate patterns in blue, red, and white, including small circular elements in various colors. The bottom section of the garment features horizontal bands, including a pink band above a blue band decorated with small triangular shapes, a yellow band, and multiple fine border lines in different colors. Handwritten notes and labels appear beneath each object, providing brief descriptions and other information. The artist's signature and date are visible beneath the left object.
title: Vessel and Skirt
